evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 记忆星脑 · Memory Nebula v2 🧠

meow-memory 记忆库的 **3D 神经元面板**，双形态：

- **DSH 桌面插件** `dsh-memory-brain`：左侧栏「🧠 记忆星脑」内嵌小界面 + ⧉ 完整网页（同源路由 `/memory-brain/*`）
- **独立网页**（备用）：`start.bat` / `python server.py`，仅本机 `http://127.0.0.1:8643`

## 八大固定分区（节点强制归类）

| 分区 | 内容 | 遗忘 |
|---|---|---|
| 🧠 大脑中枢·行为准则 | rules | **不淡化** |
| 📦 插件生态 | 自动扫描 profile：🟢在用 🟡闲置 已卸载（红点带卸载时间/原因/缺陷备注） | 状态驱动 |
| 🧩 技能库 | 自动扫描 SKILL.md：✅掌握 ⏳学习 ❌待优化；依赖插件自动连线，插件移除→淡线+【依赖插件已移除】 | 掌握不淡化 |
| 🗂 记忆库·项目档案 | project + 步骤清单（待执行/进行中/已完成/阻塞） | 正常 |
| 🧜 海马体·事实 | fact | **不淡化** |
| 💖 用户灵魂 | user + soul（人设/偏好） | **不淡化** |
| 📝 论衡·经验复盘 | lesson | 正常 |
| 💬 语言中枢·话题 | topic | 正常遗忘曲线 |

## 视图（对标生物神经元）

- 节点=细小柔和圆点（禁大光球）；连线=纤细半透明神经丝（低饱和）
- 检索/点击/激活时**光脉冲沿连线流动**；激活节点柔和高亮闪光；高频节点呼吸闪烁；衰减>70% 缓慢变暗
- 8 集群球面分离排布，一眼可辨；左侧「检索/编辑/统计」面板保留（管理操作台）
- 悬停看详情、拖拽单节点、Shift 多选后「✨ 标记为当前激活」

## 数据

- 记忆读写：`.dsh-meow/memory.db`（与插件同格式，WAL 并发安全）
- 侧车：`.dsh-meow/nebula.json`（卸载登记 `uninstalls`、项目步骤 `steps`、技能标记 `skill_marks`、激活集合 `active`）
- 扫描源：profile `package.json` dependencies + node_modules 包体 + 各包 `skills/*/SKILL.md`

## API（/api 前；插件版挂 /memory-brain/api）

`GET health|graph|memories|memory|stats|nebula`，`POST memory|memory/update|memory/delete|memory/touch|nebula`
含 id 前缀歧义守卫、Origin 写栅栏；仅本机。

## 生效

桌面插件改动需重启 DSH；独立版 `start.bat` 即起。参考视觉：luoluo-121/neural-creator-dashboard（已按其 LICENSE 仅借鉴思路，代码为本项目原创实现）。

## v3 新增：聚焦视图 · 配置总线 · 插件直通操作

- **聚焦视图**：点击任意分区枢纽 → 中央集群放大居中、其余 7 区变暗缩小（平滑过渡）；右侧=该分区条目列表（按调用频次排序、悬浮高亮、点击展开）；底部=统计表格（总数/活跃占比/状态数/频次排行）；点空白星空返回总览。左侧管理操作台不变。
- **全局配置总线**：主源=🧠大脑中枢（rules）+💖用户灵魂（user/soul）。主源保存自动推送（版本+1，A 类且跟随的插件记同步日志）；编辑台「📡 总线」按钮看快照/立即推送/B 类快照卡片复制；冲突裁决 override/separate/merge（`POST /api/bus/resolve`）；每插件独立「跟随全局人设」开关存 nebula.follows；全部动作写 nebula.sync_log（论衡区可查）。
- **插件生态直通操作**（聚焦插件区→右侧条目，可切「直通/只读」）：启用/禁用=改 profile bundles 清单；卸载=移出 bundles+登记红节点（时间/原因/缺陷）；重装=撤销登记；全部**重启 DSH 生效**，操作日志自动写入论衡复盘。黑名单保护：meow-memory / dsh-memory-brain / dshmarket / dsh-ops 等拒绝面板卸载。
- **中文化**：插件/技能说明走内置中文映射（46/49 覆盖，未覆盖保留英文原文并标注）；技能 desc_en 字段留原文。
- 新路由：`GET /api/bus`，`POST /api/bus/push`、`/api/bus/resolve`、`/api/plugin/action`。

## v4 增补（动画/看板/主题）

- **空闲自转**：总览绕 Y 轴缓转（图例可开关），聚焦停；**节点呼吸三级幅度**（激活闪光/高频明显呼吸/低频微弱）；连线持续低密度流光。
- **聚焦容错**：镜头优先 450ms 补间居中→面板异步加载→1.5s 超时提示不锁死；点簇区域（含 130px 感应圈）即聚焦，任意状态跨分区直切，点空白复位；点单节点只开详情。
- **底部看板**：指标卡+状态分布条+TOP5 排行+最近 5 条日志，可切「☰ 简易表格模式」。
- **🎨 主题/背景**：自动读 DSH 桌面 CSS 变量（失败静默降级）；背景三模式 A 跟随壁纸引擎（`GET /api/wallpaper-frame?id=` 代理缓存帧，无权限降级星空）/ B 内置星空 / C 自定义图；四色自定义+预设，存 `nebula.theme`。
- 翻译预加载：中文映射随 graph 下发，点击不现翻。

## v5 增补（4.1-4.4）

- **完整网页（4.1）**：iframe 每 1.5s 把聚焦分区+相机状态写入 hash；顶栏按钮读取 hash 带状态在系统默认浏览器打开；唤起失败自动复制链接并显示可点降级条；打开页从 hash 恢复同款视角。
- **轨道控制（4.2）**：左键旋转/右键平移/滚轮缩放+阻尼惯性；按下位移>4px 判拖拽不触发点击；悬停/点按钮**不停自转**，仅聚焦或拖拽时停，松手闲置 5s 恢复；缩放限制 60~1600 防穿模。
- **双轨流光（4.3)**：常驻氛围流光稳定节拍（聚焦簇内加密、远端微弱）；后台真实读写/召回/同步/插件操作经 `GET /api/events` 环形队列轮询，在对应节点连线发射更快更亮的高亮业务信号。
- **聚焦舒展（4.4）**：~450ms 内镜头居中+簇锚点上移 26（避开底部看板）+簇内节点散开 1.28 倍同步执行；远端 7 簇保持 12%~25% 淡轮廓与微流光。

## v6 增补（4.5 主题面板重做 + 4.1 唤起修复）

- **主题面板（4.5）**：左右分栏——左侧独立小渲染器实时预览（改色/切背景/拨开关即时可见，不点保存不落库）；右侧控件：四色「拾色器色块 + 色号输入框」双联动、预置配色小卡片（深海青/绯樱/松墨，色点缩略图一键套用）、背景三模式（跟随壁纸/星空/上传本地图片）、四个功能开关独立成行（文字标签/脉冲流光/连接线/空间自转）。底部【↺ 重置为默认】【取消=回滚草稿】【应用并保存=固化进 nebula.theme】。开关状态并入主题持久化，内嵌/网页共用互通。
- **完整网页（4.1 修复）**：三通道唤起——window.open → anchor 合成点击（Electron setWindowOpenHandler 对二者处理路径可能不同）→ 兜底显示链接+自动复制剪贴板；降级条常驻可手动点击重试。

## v7 增补（4.1 根治 / 4.2 交互放开 / 4.5 壁纸数据源分级）

- **完整网页根治**：桌面壳主窗经 `dsh-app://` 代理加载，页面 `location` 拼不出 http 地址（此前复制的 dsh-app:// 链接浏览器打不开属预期）。现先 `GET /api/ext-url` 向后端要真实 `http://host` 前缀（后端读 Host 头），再走三通道唤起；主窗 setWindowOpenHandler 实测对 http/https 都会 shell.openExternal，通道 1 即可命中。
- **4.2 交互放开**：相机补间只在聚焦/返回后 650ms 内生效，过渡结束完全交还控制权——总览下左键全方位旋转、右键无限制平移不再被每帧拉回；自转独立于补间（总览持续转、悬停/点按钮不停、聚焦停、拖拽松手闲置 5s 恢复）；缩放仅保留 60~1600 防穿模宽松阈值。
- **4.5 壁纸数据源分级**：①优先 DSH 壁纸引擎 GPU 实时帧（当前壁纸 id 匹配，15s 保鲜）→ ②引擎无帧时降级读 Windows 系统桌面壁纸（注册表 WallPaper），右下角小字提示「壁纸引擎未运行，已切换系统桌面图」→ ③都失败自动切内置星空不报错。下拉选项更名「跟随 DSH 壁纸引擎」。

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # DeepSeek Harness · Türkçe dil paketi DeepSeek Harness arayüzünü Türkçe kullanın. Sohbet, ayarlar, eklenti yönetimi ve desteklenen eklenti açıklamaları için topluluk tarafından geliştirilen dil paketi. **Türkçe** · [English](README.en.md) [0.0.3 sürümünü indir](https://github.com/akaydesu/dsh-language/releases/tag/v0.0.3) · [Kurulum rehberi](docs/installation.tr.md) · [Sürüm notları](CHANGELOG.md) · [Geri bildirim](https://github.com/akaydesu/dsh-language/issues) ![Türkçe DeepSeek Harness başlangıç ekranı](docs/images/overview-tr.png) ## Kapsam - Sohbet ekranı, gezinme menüleri, ayarlar ve bildirimler. - Dosya önizlemeleri, araç işlem durumları, izin ve hata mesajları. - Eklenti yönetimi ile desteklenen yerleşik ve deneysel eklentilerin başlık ve açıklamaları. - Ayarlardan Türkçe ve İngilizce arasında geçiş; dil tercihinin sonraki açılışlarda korunması. | Sürüm bilgisi | Değer | |---|---| | Dil paketi | **0.0.3** | | Doğrulanan DSH sürümü | **0.2.1-rc.5** | | Çeviri kapsamı | 64 arayüz bölümü, 2.909 metin | | Eklenti metinleri | 308 açıklama, 27 görünen başlık | | Çalışma zamanı bağımlılığı | Yok | Bu paket bağımsız bir topluluk çalışmasıdır; DeepSeek tarafından yayımlanan resmî bir dil paketi değildir. ## Kurulum ### Hangi alana hangi adres yazılır? | DSH alanı | Girilecek adres | |---|---| | **Plugins → Add plugin → Package name or address** | Sürümün `.tgz` bağlantısı veya yerel paket yolu | | **Plugins → Discover → Add index source** | Yalnızca aşağıdaki `market-index.json` katalog adresi | > **Paket alanına yalnızca `dsh-language` yazmayın.** DSH bunu npm paket adı olarak yorumlar. npm’deki aynı adlı paket bu projeye ait değildir ve `dsh.bundle` içermez. Bu dil paketini kurmak için aşağıdaki `.tgz` bağlantısını kullanın. ### Bağlantıyla kurulum **1. Eklentiler sayfasını açın.** DeepSeek Harness’te sol menüden **Plugins**, ardından sağ üstten **Add plugin** seçin. ![Plugins sayfası ve sağ üstte Add plugin düğmesi](docs/images/setup-plugins-en.png) **2. Paket bağlantısını yapıştırın.** Açılan **Add plugin** penceresindeki **Package name or address** alanına aşağıdaki adresi girin ve **Install** seçin: ```text https://github.com/akaydesu/dsh-language/releases/download/v0.0.3/dsh-language-0.0.3.tgz ``` ![Örnek paket bağlantısının Add plugin penceresine yazılması; görselde 0.0.2 gösterilir](docs/images/setup-url-en.png) **3. Paketi etkinleştirin.** Kurulum tamamlandığında **Enable now** düğmesini seçin. Yeniden başlatma bildirimi gösterilirse uygulamayı kapatıp açın. ![Enable now düğmesi; görselde 0.0.2 gösterilir](docs/images/setup-enable-en.png) **4. Dili kontrol edin.** Sol alt menüden **Settings → General → Language → Türkçe** yolunu izleyin. İlk etkinleştirmede Türkçe otomatik seçilebilir; daha önceki dil tercihiniz de korunabilir. ![Settings ekranında Türkçe dil seçimi](docs/images/language-en.png) Bu `.tgz` bağlantısını **Add plugin** penceresinde kullanın; **Index sources** alanına yazmayın. **Official npm registry** seçili kalabilir; paket doğrudan bağlantıdan indirilir. ### Dosyayla kurulum 1. [0.0.3 sürüm sayfasını](https://github.com/akaydesu/dsh-language/releases/tag/v0.0.3) açın. **Assets** bölümünden **`dsh-language-0.0.3.tgz`** dosyasını indirin. Arşivi açmayın. 2. DSH’de **Plugins → Add plugin** bölümüne gidin. 3. **Package name or address** alanına indirdiğiniz dosyanın tam yolunu yapıştırın ve **Install** düğmesini seçin. 4. Kurulum tamamlandığında **Enable now** düğmesini seçin. DSH yeniden başlatma bildirimi gösterirse uygulamayı tamamen kapatıp açın. 5. İlk etkinleştirmede arayüz Türkçeye geçer. Gerekirse **Settings → General → Language → Türkçe** yolundan dili seçin. Windows’ta dosyaya sağ tıklayıp **Yol olarak kopyala** seçeneğini kullanabilirsiniz. Örnek yol ve ekran görüntüleri için [ayrıntılı kurulum rehberine](docs/installation.tr.md) bakın. ### Keşfet üzerinden kurulum **Plugins → Experimental plugins → More** bölümünden **Custom plugin markets** özelliğini etkinleştirin. Ardından **Plugins → Discover → Add index source** alanına şu JSON adresini ekleyin: ```text https://raw.githubusercontent.com/akaydesu/dsh-language/main/market-index.json ``` Katalogdan **Türkçe dil paketi** kaydını seçip kurun ve etkinleştirin. Katalogdaki sürümler belirli commit’lere sabitlenmiştir. Bu alana GitHub depo sayfasını veya `.tgz` bağlantısını yazmayın. ### Sık karşılaşılan kurulum hataları | Hata | Çözüm | |---|---| | `$.format must be 1` | Katalog alanına JSON indeks yerine başka bir adres girilmiştir. Yanlış kaynağı kaldırıp yukarıdaki `market-index.json` adresini ekleyin. | | `dsh-language declares no dsh.bundle` | Yalnızca `dsh-language` yazdıysanız DSH, npm’deki farklı paketi bulmuştur. **Add plugin** alanında sürümün tam `.tgz` adresini kullanın. | ## Dil seçimi Sol alt menüden **Ayarlar → Genel → Dil** bölümünü açın. **Türkçe** veya **English** seçimi anında uygulanır. İlk otomatik Türkçe geçişinden sonra paket, sonraki dil tercihinizi değiştirmez. ![Türkçe ve İngilizce dil seçimi](docs/images/language-tr.png) ## Güncelleme ve kaldırma 1. Yeni sürümün `.tgz` bağlantısını kopyalayın veya dosyasını indirin. 2. **Plugins → Add plugin** alanına bağlantıyı veya yerel dosya yolunu girip **Install** seçin. 3. DSH isterse paketi etkinleştirin veya uygulamayı yeniden başlatın; gerekirse **Ayarlar → Genel → Dil** bölümünden Türkçe seçin. Yalnızca İngilizceye dönmek için dil seçimini değiştirmeniz yeterlidir. [Güncelleme ve sorun giderme](docs/installation.tr.md#güncelleme). ## Uyumluluk ve sınırlar - Çeviriler DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** kaynak metinlerini temel alır. Paket `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0` aralığını kabul eder; bu aralıktaki her sürüm ayrı ayrı doğrulanmış değildir. - Paket yüklenmeden önceki ilk açılış ekranı, DSH’nin sağladığı bazı araç/komut açıklamaları ve model sağlayıcılarının dinamik etiketleri İngilizce kalabilir. - Marka adları, paket kimlikleri, kod, komutlar ve sürüm numaraları korunur. Paket, modelin ürettiği yanıtları veya kullanıcı belgelerini çevirmez. - Yeni DSH sürümleriyle eklenen metinler, dil paketinde karşılığı bulunana kadar İngilizce gösterilebilir. Güncelleme yalnızca yeni paket bu metinleri içeriyorsa çeviri sağlar. ## Geri bildirim ve geliştirme [Issues](https://github.com/akaydesu/dsh-language/issues) üzerinden DSH sürümünü, dil paketi sürümünü, ekranın adını ve önerdiğiniz ifadeyi paylaşabilirsiniz. Ekran görüntülerinden kişisel bilgileri ve API anahtarlarını kaldırın. `main` dalı dağıtım dosyalarını ve kullanıcı belgelerini içerir. Çeviri kaynakları, üretim araçları ve testler [dev dalında](https://github.com/akaydesu/dsh-language/tree/dev) bulunur. Katkı kuralları: [çeviri rehberi](https://github.com/akaydesu/dsh-language/blob/dev/TRANSLATION-GUIDE.md). ## Lisans [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). DeepSeek Harness ve ilgili marka adları kendi sahiplerine aittir. Ekran görüntüleri DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 üzerinde, örnek bir profilde alınmıştır.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-tg-bridge

Drive [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com) from Telegram. It runs on the
machine that already has the harness, and it answers in the chat where you asked.

A forum topic is a project: its own session, working directory, model,
permissions and language. Two topics share the install and nothing else.

Never made a bot? [QUICKSTART.md](QUICKSTART.md) goes from "no account" to a bot
that answers, one step at a time.

## What it does

- **A model per topic.** `/model` lists the routes the profile declares — provider
  and model together — and a tap switches this topic only. `/model <route> all`
  moves the default the other topics follow; `/model auto` hands the topic back.
  A chat for thinking out loud and a chat for engineering no longer share one model.
- **A topic is a project.** `/cd my-app`, and every turn runs from that directory —
  on a permission-enabled profile the sandbox is narrowed to it too, so the agent
  cannot write outside the project.
- **One edited message per turn.** Steps, a timer and the cache hit rate, plus the
  reasoning in a collapsed block you can tap open. A long turn adds a second
  collapsed block with every tool call. `/stop` is a button on that message.
- **`/diff` — review the turn, one hunk at a time.** The working tree is split into
  files and hunks; every hunk gets two buttons: explain it, or revert just that
  hunk. A button carries a hash of the hunk it was drawn from, so a press that
  arrives after the file moved on is refused instead of touching a line nobody was
  looking at. `/diff stat` is the file list alone.
- **An endpoint from the chat.** `/endpoint add <id> <https://url/v1> <KEY_ENV>
  [model,model]` writes the provider without an AI turn, and the key itself is
  never typed — only the name of the variable that holds it. The new models appear
  on `/model` as routes.
- **Input: text, voice, photos.** Any speech engine plugs in — a local script, any
  command-line tool, or an OpenAI-compatible API (see [`docs/VOICE.md`](docs/VOICE.md))
  — and the transcript is shown before the answer. A photo is read by the turn's own
  model through `read_image`, text and UI included; no second model is needed.
- **Goal and checklist per topic.** `/goal`, `/tasks`; both survive restarts and
  are prepended to every turn.
- **Two scopes for every setting.** `/reasoning <mode> all` moves the default,
  without `all` it moves this topic; language and pinning follow the same rule,
  and `/crew use reviewer` gives one topic its own effort, permissions and agent
  preset (four built-in sets, read-only, copyable).
- **It says what it cost.** A turn reports tokens and the cache hit rate; `/cost`
  says what the session has spent and `/prices` shows the rates it used.
- **Out of quota is not a dead end.** When the quota runs out it switches to a
  free model right away, and the answer says which route answered.
- **No lost messages.** A journal with acknowledgement and replay.
- **Knows how busy the computer is.** `/load` shows free space on the topic's disk,
  free RAM and average CPU, plus how many turns are running and waiting. `/load on`
  makes a prompt wait instead of starting while the machine is over a limit you set
  — kept, never refused, and one press sends it anyway.
- **Languages.** Menus and service messages in `en`, `ru`, `zh`; `/lang` pins the
  topic language, and without it a new topic takes the language of the message
  itself (Cyrillic → `ru`, Han characters → `zh`), then the Telegram
  `language_code`, then `en`.
- **"Stop" / "Retry" buttons and tool confirmations** sit in the message, so there
  is no command to type to stop a run.
- **`/report`.** One command turns "it broke" into a redacted document: version,
  profile, preset, model, directory, the last failure and the log tail, with keys
  and home paths removed before the file is written.
- **`dsh-tg check`.** Diagnostics in one command, changing nothing on the system.

## First run

`setup.mjs` leaves a working bridge with these defaults, and none of them need
a decision before the first message:

| Setting | Default | Where to change it |
|---|---|---|
| profile | `headless` | `/profile` |
| folder | the workspace you ran setup in | `/cd` |
| idle limit | 2 minutes without output stops the turn | `/settings` |
| hard ceiling | none — a long turn runs until it ends | `/settings` |
| parallel turns | 3 | `/settings` |
| plain text | off (Markdown answers) | `/settings` |
| model fallback | on, empty chain | `/fallback` |
| voice messages | off | `/voice` |
| topic log | on | `/settings` |
| command menu | installed for this bot | `node bot-menu.mjs` |

The first three commands are enough to be productive: `/cd <project>` binds the
topic to a folder, `/model` picks the model with buttons, `/menu` is every
command as a card, grouped. `/start` answers with the same three and offers a five-step tour — folder, model, files, the turn and the way back, the switches — each step naming one command as a button; `/help`
explains any command in one message; `/settings` holds the switches above.

## Requirements

- Node.js ≥ 24 (the version DeepSeek Harness ships; sessions are zstd-compressed)
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer in the `0.2.x` line (`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`)
- DeepSeek Harness installed (`~/.dsh/profiles/headless`)
- A Telegram bot token from [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather)

The supported harness range is declared in `engines.dsh`; that field decides
compatibility on its own (DSH ignores `peerDependencies` when it is present).
The range includes an explicit prerelease branch, because a plain `<0.3.0`
silently excludes `0.2.2-*` builds. A future `0.3.0` needs an explicit bump:
the bridge relies on the `0.2.x` CLI flags and profile layout.

## Ecosystem

The Chinese DSH community maintains the largest plugin catalogs and the
in-app markets that read them; this bridge follows their packaging rules so it
can be listed next to them:

- [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) — bilingual (English /
  中文) plugin list and the `dsh-plugin-catalog` npm package
- [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) — the Chinese-built
  in-app market with one-click install and themes
- [dsh-find-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin) —
  finds a plugin from chat instead of browsing a catalog

## Languages

- Menus (`/` in chat): three sets, `ru` by default, plus `en` and `zh`; a client whose locale matches neither gets the Russian set.
- Topic language: `/lang en|ru|zh`; stored in `state.json` and survives a restart.
- A new user gets the language from the Telegram `language_code`; anything that is not `ru`/`zh` → `en`.
- Translated so far: menus, the start message, turn status, errors, `/cd`, `/new`, `/stop`, `/lang`,
  the reply to an unknown command. Long reports (`/status`, `/sessions`, `/model` and similar)
  are still in Russian, that is the next pass.

## Installation

One command: your bot token and your numeric id. Nothing to edit by hand.

**Windows, macOS or Linux — Node.js 24 or newer.** `init` and the bridge run
anywhere; `setup` (stop, autostart, restart) is **Windows-only** today, so on
macOS and Linux use `sh install.sh`, which registers `launchd` or `systemd --user`.
`node setup.mjs --check` reports state on every platform.

```bash
npx dsh-tg-bridge@latest init --token 123456789:AA... --user 123456789
npx dsh-tg-bridge@latest setup
```

`init` writes the token, your id and the working directory; `setup` registers
autostart and starts the bridge.

### What it needs from DSH

The bridge is a client of the DSH CLI, and the surface it uses is small enough to
write down: `--profile`, `--json`, `--session-id`, `--expose-internals <cli.js>`
when the app binary runs the CLI, and the `{"type": ...}` JSON events on stdout.
Profiles are read as files (`cordis.patch.yml`, `package.json`) under
`~/.dsh/profiles`. `package.json` spells the supported range out in
`engines.dsh`, and it is capped below `0.3.0` on purpose: a minor bump may rename
an event, and a bridge that guesses is a bridge that answers with silence.

Two escape hatches, for a moved app or a DSH that ships differently:

```bash
DSH_BIN=/usr/local/bin/dsh        # the CLI itself, no entrypoint argument
DSH_CLI_JS=/opt/dsh/lib/cli.js    # just the CLI entrypoint, run by DSH_BIN
DSH_APP_DIR=/opt/DeepSeek-Harness # where the desktop app is installed
```

`/doctor` prints the command a turn would actually run, so a machine where these
matter says so instead of failing with an empty answer.

**As a DSH plugin** (the package carries a `dsh.bundle`; the catalog entry is
pending review):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tg-bridge
```

The plugin starts one bridge when DSH boots and stops it on shutdown; if a
bridge is already running (for example from the scheduled task), it leaves it
alone. Run `npx dsh-tg-bridge@latest init ...` first so a config exists.

What `init` does:

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| bot token | `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` → `refs.DSH_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`; other keys are left alone |
| your id and working directory | `~/.dsh/tg-bridge/config.json`; an existing file is not overwritten |
| `headless` profile | checked, with a hint on how to create it if missing |

`init` flags: `--cwd <path>` (default `~/Projects`), `--voice` (enable
voice transcription), `--dry-run` (show what would be written, change nothing).

Optional provider settings live in `config.json`:

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `providerKeys` | extra env var names to pass to a turn, read from `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`; default `[]` |
| `pricesUrl` | retired: `/prices` always reads OpenRouter's public list and labels the number as a reference for the model |
| `vision.patch` | opt-in overlay profile for photo turns; default `""` — the turn's own model reads images |
| `vision.enabled` | set `true` to run photo turns on `vision.patch` instead of the topic profile |
| `fallbackModels` | ordered failover chain; default `[]` — see below |
| `fallbackEnabled` | `false` switches the whole chain off without editing the list; `/fallback off` sets it |
| `maxParallel` | how many topics run at once, 1–8, default `3`; also `/jobs 5` in the chat |
| `replayWindowMs` | how old a journaled update may be and still be replayed after a restart; default `600000` (10 min) |

Each `fallbackModels` entry is one attempt, tried in order after the turn's own
model refuses:

```json
{
  "provider": "router-a",
  "model": "some-model",
  "patch": "~/.dsh/tg-bridge/model-a.yml",
  "free": false,
  "off": false
}
```

`patch` is an overlay file with a single `agent-default-model` row
(`provider` + `model`); it is materialised once as its own profile, so the turn
keeps every other setting and only the model changes. `provider` is the id the
provider is written under in the profile — it decides whose key and host the
pre-flight probe asks, so the same model id on two routers stays two attempts.
`free` only adds `(free)` to the switch notice. `off` keeps an entry in the list
but out of the walk; an entry whose `patch` file is missing is skipped the same
way, and the chat says so instead of counting it.

The chain may mix companies: a 503 from one provider says nothing about another,
so a busy channel skips its own models and the next company is still tried. Put
models from different companies next to each other — two arms of one router are
one outage, not two chances — and keep the `:free` models at the end, as the
last resort.

**What starts a switch.** Anything the provider itself says no to: a 400/413/422
refusal (its own validator rejecting the request), 401/403 (key refused), 402 or
a quota/balance message (empty account), 404 (that model id is not carried),
429 (rate limit), 5xx and `get_channel_failed` / "all providers busy" (the pool
is down), a dropped connection or DNS/TLS failure, and an empty answer. A refusal
gets one other route, not the whole chain: it is replayed in full, and if the
second vendor refuses identically the request — not the route — is what is wrong,
so the reply says to start a fresh session with `/new`.

**What does not start a switch.** The turn time cap, `/stop`, a session or
directory error, a missing `dsh` binary: no other vendor changes those, and a
replay would cost a full turn to learn the same thing. They are listed in the
card so the distinction is visible instead of guessed.

### `/fallback` — the chain from the chat

```
/fallback                 the card: chain state, numbered routes, what starts a switch
/fallback on | off        the whole chain (per route: /fallback off 3)
/fallback use 3 | skip 3  one route back in or out
/fallback up 3 | down 3   move a route in the order
/fallback test [3]        ask each route (or one) with a 1-token request
/fallback add <provider>/<model>     write an overlay and append the route
/fallback first <provider>/<model>   put it at the head: tried before every other route
/fallback remove 3        drop a route from the list (its overlay file stays)
```

Every line has a button on the card: `● n` switches a route, `↑ n` / `↓ n` move
it, and the card redraws in place after each press. `test` proves the key and the
channel are alive — not that the provider accepts this conversation, so a route
can answer `ping` and still refuse a long prompt with a 400. The card says that
in as many words.

`test` also times each route: how long it takes to produce the first token, and
which live route is fastest right now. Two routes that both answer are not
equally good — 400 ms and 9 s feel like different products — and the head of the
chain is the one a person picks on that number. A route that did not answer
prints no time, so `no balance · 120 ms` can never read as "works, just slow".

`first` exists because `add` appends: when the route you want should answer
*before* the primary, appending it means moving it up eight times and guessing
where the head is. `/fallback first router-a/deepseek-v4.1-flash` writes the
same overlay and puts it at position 1 — or moves it there if it is already in
the chain.

Get your id from [@userinfobot](https://t.me/userinfobot), the token from
[@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather).

### Bot settings in Telegram

Three things without which the bot will stay silent in a group or work only halfway:

1. **Privacy mode → Disable** (`/setprivacy` in BotFather). Otherwise the bot sees
   only commands, not regular text in a topic.
2. **Topics enabled** in the group settings (Edit → Topics). Without them all work
   goes to a single chat and per-topic sessions are not created.
3. **Pin Messages** permission for the bot. Only needed to pin the first
   message of a topic; without it the bridge keeps working but will not pin.

You do not need to set up the command menu by hand: `init` and `setup` install it
in Russian, English and Chinese at once. The menu is not refreshed by a plain
bridge restart, so after adding commands run `dsh-tg menu`. The full settings
table, permissions, checks and common errors are in
[docs/TELEGRAM-SETUP.md](https://github.com/aleksvega/dsh-tg-bridge/blob/master/docs/TELEGRAM-SETUP.md).

**Autostart** has two routes. `sh install.sh` writes `launchd` on macOS and
`systemd --user` on Linux; `dsh-tg setup` registers the `DSH-TG-Bridge` task on
Windows, which runs the guarded supervisor (the same launcher on logon and every
five minutes) so a crashed bridge comes back without a second poller. On macOS
and Linux `setup` declines and names `install.sh`, because it stops the old
bridge with `taskkill` and registers autostart through `schtasks`.

**Manual install** (if you want full control):

```bash
npm install -g dsh-tg-bridge
dsh-tg init --token 123456789:AA... --user 123456789
dsh-tg check     # report only, changes nothing
dsh-tg setup     # stop the old bridge and start the new one
```

If the bridge is already installed, `setup` restarts it on the new code and reinstalls
the command menu.

## Troubleshooting

Starting from nothing, or helping someone who is: [QUICKSTART.md](QUICKSTART.md)
has the same answers with the terminal output they will actually see.

Error replies end with a code, which tells you what to fix:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `INSUFFICIENT_QUOTA` | provider balance is empty: top up or stay on free models (`/prices`, `/model`) |
| `TG_CONFLICT` | a second process is polling the same bot: `/doctor`, then `/restart` |
| `TG_POLL` | Telegram did not answer a long poll inside its own clock. The bridge retried by itself; one line is nothing, a run of them for minutes is VPN/DNS or a route that died |
| `TG_NET` | no network to Telegram at all: the bridge keeps retrying, nothing was lost |
| `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` | no provider key in the profile: add it in the DSH app |
| `NO_DSH_CLI` | DeepSeek Harness CLI not found: check the app installation |
| `NETWORK` | no network to the provider: retry, check VPN/DNS |
| `SANDBOX_DENY` | DSH denied access to a file or directory: check the project path and permissions |
| `UNKNOWN_MODEL` | the model from the config is unavailable: `/model` lists the working ones |
| `EMPTY_RESPONSE` | the model returned nothing: retry or switch model (`/model`) |
| `TURN_TIME_CAP` | the turn hit its own time ceiling: the work is saved, press Continue |
| `TURN_FAILED` | cause not recognized: `/doctor` and `/logs errors` |

### Lines in the bridge log

Not every line is an error, and the ones that are usually name their own cause.
These are the phrases people actually ask about — the first word of each is what
to search for in `/logs`:

| The line | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `poll error [TG_POLL]: The operation was aborted due to timeout — retry in 5s` | Telegram held the long poll past its own timeout. The bridge dropped it and asked again, which is the normal way to poll | nothing, if it is one line; if it repeats for minutes, check VPN/DNS |
| `poll error [TG_NET]: fetch failed` | no route to Telegram | it keeps retrying; fix the network |
| `Conflict: terminated by other getUpdates request` | two processes poll the same token — a second bridge, or `dsh web` started its own | `/doctor` shows the pid; `/restart confirm` or stop the other copy |
| `no activity for 2 min — turn interrupted` | the model went silent past the idle limit; the turn was stopped | `/stop` if it is still marked busy, then resend. `/settings` moves the limit |
| `the CLI exited with code 1 and printed nothing` | DSH itself did not start, so the turn never existed | `/doctor`, then `/logs errors`; `/dsh` shows the installed version |
| `[DSH] is not at <path>` | the topic's profile points at a path with no DSH | install DSH, or `/dsh` for the check |
| `could not start the DSH turn` | spawn failed — permissions, disk, antivirus | the message carries the system reason |
| `The button failed — /logs errors has the reason` | the card outlived the state it pointed at, usually after a restart | `/menu` draws a fresh card |
| `the provider cut the request off at its own 60-second ceiling` | the provider closed the stream, not the bridge | the fallback chain takes over; `/fallback` shows it |
| `turn ended without an answer` | the stream finished with no text and no error | retry; if it repeats, `/model` another route |

A turn that fails on purpose says so in words — "the sandbox refused", "the
provider ran out of its own clock" — because a person reading it is deciding
what to do next, not debugging.

## Checks

Send the bot:

| Command | Expected |
|---|---|
| `/doctor` | report: pid, Telegram, disk, directory, session |
| `/update` | which bridge runs, what npm has, and whether a newer release exists (`/update confirm` installs it) |
| `/thoughts [file\|all\|off]` | the last turn's reasoning as a message; `file`/`all` send the full log as a Markdown document, `off` hides the block |
| `/help` | commands grouped by category |
| `/cd my-app` | topic bound to the project, and the sandbox narrowed to it |
| `/diff [stat]` | what the turn changed, one hunk at a time: every hunk has "explain" and "revert this hunk"; a stale button is refused |
| `/find <text> [path]` | where a literal string lives in the topic's folder: matches as buttons that open the file at the matched line; binary and oversized files are skipped and counted |
| `/report` | a redacted bundle (version, profile, preset, model, cwd, last failure, log tail) sent to the owner as a document; in a group, the path only |
| `/prices` | what the current model costs, and whose price that is: your provider's, the same model on another gateway, or "no public price" when nobody publishes one |

## Commands

```
Work:         /cd · /new · /stop · /send · /seed · /diff · /find <text> [path]
Goals:        /goal (plan + checklist) · /goal reopen · /tasks (checklist only) · /tasks done|rm|edit <n>
Sessions:     /status · /sessions · /sessions <id> · /rewind [n|undo|fork [n]|branches]
Agents:       /agents · /agents <id> · /agents set model|depth|filter
Models:       /model · /model <route> · /model <route> all · /model auto · /endpoint · /prices
Tuning:       /effort · /permissions · /preset · /plan · /jobs · /remind · /every
Profiles:     /profile · /profile <name> · /profile new <name> from <template>
Sets:         /crew · /crew use|off|new|copy|rm · /crew model <v>
Extensions:   /skills · /plugins · /plugins search <word> · /plugins disable|enable <id> · /soul
Updates:      /update · /update confirm · /update on|off|check|auto · /subscribe on|off
Diagnostics:  /doctor · /logs [errors|N|text] · /report
Service:      /app · /restart · /help
Machine:      /load · /load on|off · /load limit cpu|ram|disk <n>
Settings:     /settings — the same switches as buttons, grouped in four tabs
Display:      /lang · /reasoning off|card|chat · /pin on|off · /thoughts
```

### Settings as a card

`/settings` draws the same switches that the commands set, in one message with
four tabs: what the bot says, who answers and how hard it works, new releases,
and the health checks. Each row shows what the setting is now and what a tap
would change it to. A tap runs the command a person would have typed
(`/reasoning chat`, `/update on`), so the card cannot disagree with the command:
it is a view of them.

The card stays after a tap. It is edited in place — same message, same buttons,
the value in force marked with `●` and one `✓ row: value` line saying what just
changed — so a second setting is one more tap instead of a second `/settings`.
`✓ Done` removes the card when you are finished with it; nothing else deletes it.

`📌 Pin the progress card` (`/pin on`) keeps the running card pinned, so the
clock, the speed and the step list are one tap away instead of a scroll. Telegram
gives a chat one pinned message, so each turn's card replaces the last one. Off by
default: a bot that pins without being asked takes that slot in someone else's
chat, and a group needs the right to pin at all.

Nothing on the card is only available on the card. `/settings` is for people who
would rather press a labelled button than remember which of `/effort`,
`/preset` and `/crew` changes what.

Every command answers `/help` in the chat, in the language you write in: a
message written in Cyrillic or Han characters switches the topic to Russian or
Chinese even when the phone's menu is set to another language, and `/lang`
pins a choice above that. The Telegram menu shows the same list, minus
`/subscribe`: it is one line, and a person who turns it off should not have to
find it in a menu again.

## Updates

The npm tag `latest` is a label, not an updater: installing a package pins the
version on disk, and nothing moves until something moves it. Two switches, both
about this install (not about a topic, because it is the install that updates):

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/update` | one line: what runs here, what is published, which switches are set |
| `/update on` | tell me about new releases: one message per version, checked once a day |
| `/update off` | stop telling me; nothing installs, nothing moves |
| `/update auto` | besides telling me, install the release by itself (checked hourly) |
| `/update confirm` | install the new release now, by hand |

Nothing above installs except `confirm` and `auto`, and even those only change the
files: the running process keeps its old modules until `/restart confirm`, so a
bad release never lands mid-chat. `confirm` and `auto` copy the replaced files to
`update-backup-<date>` and print the path; copying that folder back is the way to
roll back, with no state to undo.

`/subscribe on|off` says the same thing as `/update on|off`, for people who do not
want to read `/update` first. It is not in the Telegram menu on purpose.

There are no notices about failures. The bridge cannot decide what counts as one
for you, and "something failed" that nobody can act on is noise; errors stay in
the chat where they happened, under `/doctor` and `/logs errors`.

## How it works

```
Telegram → bridge.mjs → dsh --profile headless --json → reply
             │
             ├─ pending/ journal + ack  (messages are not lost)
             ├─ per-topic queue         (turns in topics run in parallel)
             ├─ progress + buttons      (you can see the work is going)
             └─ fail-fast on quota      (free models as a fallback)
```

The bridge is a single process with long polling. Each turn spawns a separate
CLI process that exits after the answer, so "no DSH process" between
turns is normal, not a failure.

### Steering during a turn

If you write in a topic while a turn is still running, the message does not queue
behind it: the bridge drops the task into `~/.dsh/tg-bridge/steer/`, the `dsh-steer-inbox`
plugin hands it to the live agent on its next step, and the agent immediately replies with a short
line in the chat: what it is doing now and where it put the addition. If the agent stays silent
for 90 seconds, the bridge writes one neutral line itself so there is no silence.

Attachments work the same way. A voice note is transcribed first and its transcript is echoed in
the chat, then the text is steered into the running turn; a photo or a file is downloaded to a
local path and that path is steered, exactly as an idle turn would hand it over.

What each kind of attachment becomes inside a running turn:

| Sent | Inside the turn | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| voice note, audio file, audio sent as a document | transcript, echoed as `🎤 …` before the steer | any engine you point `voice` at: `script`, `command` or an OpenAI-compatible `openai` endpoint; **off by default** |
| small text file (`.md`, `.json`, `.csv`, `.py`, `.log`, … up to 60 KB) | the content itself between `<file>` markers — no tool call needed | nothing |
| PDF, archive, binary, anything bigger | its local path under `~/.dsh/tg-bridge/inbox/` | nothing; the agent opens it with its own tools |
| video, video note, animation | its path; the agent can pull frames or sound out with ffmpeg | ffmpeg, only if frames or audio are needed |
| photo | its path plus one honest line; the turn reads it with `read_image`, and says so in one line if it cannot | a model that accepts images |

Voice is the one row with a hidden prerequisite: something has to turn audio into
text. Faster-whisper is what `init --voice` writes, but it is not the only answer —
`voice.provider` also takes `command` (whisper.cpp, Vosk, a wrapper of your own) or
`openai` (OpenAI, Groq, a local server; anything that speaks
`/audio/transcriptions`). With no backend configured, a voice note is not swallowed:
the bridge says what is missing and points at [`docs/VOICE.md`](docs/VOICE.md).

A caption does not turn the attachment into a text-only message: it is folded into the same
hand-over, so "why did this fail" plus a `.log` file arrives as one steer.

An album is one request, not ten. Telegram delivers it as one update per file, all sharing a
`media_group_id`; the bridge collects the group (1.2 s of quiet after the last item, at most
4 s) and hands it over once — one steer into a running turn, one turn when the topic is idle.

### When a turn hits the time ceiling

`turnTimeoutMs` (default 30 min, this install 75) is a ceiling, not a target: if a turn reaches
it, the bridge stops it with `⏱` instead of letting one runaway loop own the topic for hours.
Nothing is lost — the session and every file the turn produced stay in place — so the message
carries **⏵ Continue**, which asks the agent to check the state and go on from where it stopped.
That is deliberately not the same as **Retry**, which would redo the whole task from the start.

This needs the plugin from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless add link:<path-to-repository>/plugin/steer-inbox
```

and a line in `~/.dsh/profiles/headless/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: steer-inbox
      name: 'dsh-steer-inbox'
```

The bridge checks the profile itself: if the line is missing, it does not write the task
(it would just expire) and behaves as before, queueing the message.

### Live thoughts and reasoning

Two things land in the same progress message, and neither sends a chat message of its own.

**The model's reasoning.** Every `thinking` block the CLI commits is folded into one
Telegram `<blockquote expandable>`: collapsed it is a single line, tapped it opens the whole
trail of the turn, and it stays there after the turn ends — the same way the desktop app shows
a reasoning section you can expand. The block is written once, in the final edit of the turn,
and never touched again: Telegram re-collapses an expanded block on every edit of its message,
which used to yank the chat away from a half-read paragraph. While the turn runs the message
only gets a counter (`🧠 Размышления · 4821`) and the last three steps, so the live edits stay
short. Escaped, and trimmed to its tail when a turn thinks longer than a message can hold; the
panel never exceeds one message. A

# dsh-cgss-idol-theme

[English](README.en.md) · [展示页](https://alycestocking.github.io/dsh-cgss-idol-theme/)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)（DSH）使用的《偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩》多角色主题：**Web 页面主题 + Windows 独立桌宠**。默认角色为佐城雪美，也可搜索姓名或罗马字切换角色。

本仓库在原 `dsh-yukimi-theme` 中合入 `dsh-idol-theme` 后更名而来，保留双方共同历史和多角色开发提交；不再是单独的雪美主题或双角色试验副本。当前包名是 `dsh-cgss-idol-theme`，内部插件条目是 `cgss-idol-theme`。

## 功能与覆盖范围

- **角色目录**：列出 190 位偶像，当前 **188 位可选**。向井拓海、村上巴因采集时返回 HTTP 567 暂列为“待收录”，不是断言其没有素材。另有 8 套缺少配套图标元数据的服装暂被排除。详见[收录报告](research/roster/README.md)与[例外清单](research/roster/coverage.json)。
- **素材目录**：可选角色包含 1,850 套服装、7,400 张小人姿态图与 3,702 张 CGSS 背景的 URL。印象色、签名、Mobamas 卡片、贴纸与过场动画按角色数据提供；并非每位角色都有贴纸或过场动画。
- **角色配色与阅读**：强调色和光晕跟随角色印象色，适配浅色/深色；聊天内容、工具和部分管理页面使用半透明磨砂底板，历史记录上下渐隐，输入卡片独立遮挡滚动内容。
- **小人互动**：拖动、单击翻转并显示台词、双击换装、长按打开角色/服装/背景选择。聚焦后可用 Enter/空格互动、菜单键打开设置、Escape 关闭设置。Windows 桌宠的设置是独立可拖动窗口；页面内面板跟随小人，闲置后收起。
- **装饰与布局**：签名水印、可选 Mobamas 轮播（默认关闭），不额外预留装饰侧栏。宽度小于 1100px 或高度小于 640px 时自动隐藏卡片与签名，小人缩小；沉浸模式另有显示规则。
- **纯背景模式**：点击聊天空白背景或按 Alt+I，临时收起侧栏、标题、输入栏和历史记录；再点背景、向上滚轮或按 Esc 恢复。历史消息与交互控件不是普通背景点击区。
- **沉浸阅读模式**：长按历史区域 650 毫秒或按 Alt+Shift+I，收起侧栏、标题与输入栏但保留可滚动的历史记录；再次长按、再次按快捷键或按 Esc 恢复。
- **台词与问候**：点击优先抽取当前服装的中文台词，再回退到公共台词或占位文本；使用洗牌队列避免一轮内重复。启动按时间问候，切换角色使用“体力已满”场景，每 10 分钟自动说一句。均为文字，**没有语音播放**。

图片从 BWiki CDN 在线加载，需要网络。上述覆盖数字来自仓库中的采集快照和结构检查，并不表示已逐张下载验图或逐角色目视验收。原始服装台词采集数据有 1,876 个服装块、95,544 条文本；其中与可选服装对应的是 1,850 个块，不能把两个统计范围混为一谈。

## Windows 桌宠

独立桌宠仅在 **Windows 的 desktop profile** 启动；普通 Web profile 不启动桌面辅助程序。透明窗口可在 DSH 主窗口最小化或隐藏后继续显示，停用插件或退出 Host 时关闭。桌宠就绪后隐藏页面内小人；启动失败时保留页面内小人。

- 监听运行中或仍有等待请求的主会话，不为子代理单独弹提醒。
- 提醒区区分正常结束、失败、中止、需要回答和需要审批，使用当前角色的场景台词，不再统一使用占位文案。正常结束仅指本轮结束，不表示整个项目已完成。
- 询问和审批保留到请求处理完；结束提醒约显示 5 秒，有等待提醒时排队。新提醒触发一次翻转；气泡显示期间维护置顶而不抢键盘焦点。
- 点击气泡唤起 Harness 并定位会话，不会自动回答或批准请求。
- 支持跨显示器拖动、屏幕边界约束和透明空白区域鼠标穿透。小人位置与设置面板位置独立保存。
- 只预热当前角色的当前服装与下一套，最多 8 张；解码缓存有并发与容量上限。换装等待解码，失败时保留原图；设置窗口不批量预热服装。

桌面偏好保存在 `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/preferences.json`，并同步到同一 desktop profile 的页面。普通 Web 页面的偏好只保留在当前页面，刷新会恢复默认值。

Host 与辅助程序通过带随机握手的本机命名管道通信，页面使用 DSH 认证 RPC。保留旧 `/yukimi` RPC 与部分内部命名以兼容现有实现；没有新增 TCP 监听端口。传给桌宠的是会话标识、标题、状态和预设台词，不包含聊天正文。

## 安装

### 从旧包迁移

仓库改名不会自动把已安装的旧包依赖改成新包。请在会话空闲时操作，并先备份桌宠偏好：

1. 在“插件”页停用并移除已安装的 `dsh-yukimi-theme` 或 `dsh-idol-theme`，再安装新包。不要同时启用新旧主题，它们共用部分 RPC、样式和存储实现。
2. `dsh-idol-theme` 的 `idol-desktop` 数据目录继续沿用。原雪美版使用 `yukimi-desktop`；本次改名**不自动搬迁该目录**，请保留原文件作为备份，需要时在新主题重新设置。
3. 安装后确认新包总开关和内部 `cgss-idol-theme` 条目均启用，再完整重启对应的 DSH 服务或桌面应用及 Host。

Web profile 可用官方 CLI 移除实际安装的旧包（没有安装的包不必执行）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-yukimi-theme
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-idol-theme
```

### Web 主题

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AlyceStocking/dsh-cgss-idol-theme
```

停止旧 Web 服务，再运行 `dsh web` 并刷新页面。仓库已经提交浏览器 JS 产物，不需要安装时再执行 prepare 构建。为固定版本，可在 GitHub 安装地址后加 `#<提交 SHA>`。

请使用官方插件管理命令或管理页面安装，不要通过手动复制到 node_modules 再手写 patch 代替正式安装。

### Windows 桌宠：从源码构建完整包

需要 Node.js **22.12.0 或以上**、npm，以及能下载 Electron 的网络。当前锁定 Electron 44.5.1，打包目标为 Windows x64。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/AlyceStocking/dsh-cgss-idol-theme.git
cd dsh-cgss-idol-theme
npm ci
npm run build:characters
npm run build:client
npm run check
npm test
npm run desktop:package
# 先停用旧主题，并在会话空闲时完整退出 DSH；脚本不会替你结束进程。
npm run desktop:install
```

GitHub 源码不包含被 Git 忽略的 Electron 二进制。独立桌宠需先打包生成 `desktop/runtime/win32-x64/CGSS Idol Desktop.exe`；仅从 GitHub 安装源码不能保证有独立桌宠可运行。下载失败时可用 `npm run desktop:package -- --electron-zip-dir <目录>` 指定本地 Electron zip 目录。

安装脚本验证完整运行时，把包含 lib、desktop 和 Electron 的不可变压缩包按内容哈希保存到 `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/packages/`，再调用 **DSH Desktop 自带 CLI** 更新 desktop profile。请保留归档供后续依赖重装使用；不修改 Harness 程序文件。仅生成包而不安装：`npm run desktop:install -- --bundle-only`。

更新已有包可能保留原有启停状态。安装成功不等于已经启用；检查包总开关及内部条目。更新 Host 代码后完整退出并重启 DSH Desktop 与 Host，单纯刷新页面或关闭主窗口可能继续使用缓存模块。

## 开发与验证

- 编辑 `lib/client.js` 中非生成区块迭代页面逻辑；素材与角色数据变更后运行 `npm run build:characters` 和 `npm run build:client`。提交生成产物，保证 GitHub 源码安装可加载。
- `npm run check` 检查语法和生成数据同步；`npm test` 检查主题清理、角色切换、台词、桌宠提醒、偏好、加载竞态、窗口边界和包身份契约。
- `npm run desktop:preview` 使用隔离的 `build/preview-data/` 和合成状态，不调用模型、不修改正式偏好。
- `desktop:sync` 仅用于临时开发同步，不能更新 profile 的依赖来源，也不是旧包更名迁移工具。正式安装使用 `desktop:install`；后续包管理器重装可能覆盖临时同步内容。
- 本轮合并通过 120 项自动化测试、Windows 桌宠打包和完整归档校验；**没有在真实 DSH GUI 中安装改名包并重新做现场验收**。历史记录及本轮验证边界见[验证记录](docs/validation.md)。

## 版权与来源

- 本仓库**代码**按 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源，作者 AlyceStocking。
- 《偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩》的角色、官方美术及原始台词等权利归 Bandai Namco Entertainment / Cygames 等相应权利人所有。本项目为非官方同人主题，不代表官方授权或合作。
- 图片来自 [BWiki imascg](https://wiki.biligame.com/imascg) 的在线 URL，仓库不打包官方图片或音频；但**确实包含采集的中文台词文本、译文及素材元数据**，并将台词嵌入客户端。因此不能声称“不分发任何官方素材”。
- 台词译文与 wiki 内容的权利及使用条件归相应权利人/贡献者，**不因存放于此仓库而纳入代码的 MIT 授权**。请遵守来源站点及权利人的条件；本项目不授予对角色、美术、原文或译文的商用许可。
- 感谢 BWiki imascg 的资料整理、翻译与维护者。素材可用性受来源站点影响，采集与结构检查不保证外链永久有效。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# qqbot-guard

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/anwesc/dsh-qqbot-guard)

**qqbot 增强层**（伴侣插件）。qqbot 主体仍由用户从插件市场安装（`@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot`），
本插件只做进程内补丁，不修改 qqbot / SDK 的任何磁盘文件。

装上之后，群里发 **大肥鱼 / 肥鱼 / 鱼鱼**（可改）就能叫醒机器人，不用 @；群历史会带上图片、语音、
文件的摘要。关键词和所有开关都在 DSH 的 **设置 → QQ 守护** 里改，保存即生效（1.1.0 起）。

本仓库是 `dsh-qqbot-guard` 的**唯一真源**（源码、测试、发布都在这里）。
两种来源，包名相同：从插件市场 / npm 单独安装（`dsh-qqbot-guard`），
或随 [dsh-android](https://github.com/anwesc/dsh-android) APK 内置（构建时从 npm 拉同一版本）。

## 它补什么

| 编号 | 现象 | 本插件的处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 群聊必须 @ 才回，关键词（如 `YONGJIE`）被 `mentionGate` 拦下 | 正文命中关键词时给 `msg.mentions` 补 `{is_you:true}`，`mentionGate` / `slashCommand` 都判成被提及 |
| 2 | 关键词触发时看不到上下文（`inbound.js:209` 只在 `wasMentioned` 时拼历史） | 同上：`wasMentioned` 变 true → `buildAgentBody` 自动带上 `[Chat history]` |
| 3 | 群历史里只剩文字，图片/语音/文件的条目是空行（`history-buffer.js:90-96` 只存 `content`） | 在链头**预下载**附件（`downloadMediaAttachments`），再包装 history store 的 `list`，给条目补 `[图片「a.png」@/…/media/a_…png、语音]` |
| 4 | 表情是占位符 `<faceType=6,faceId="0",ext="eyJ0ZXh0IjoiIn0=">`，上游只读 `ext.text`（是空的） | 解码 `ext.text` 有名字就用名字（如 `捂脸`）；为空则统一给 `[表情]`，**不按 `faceId` 猜**（见下方第 5 条风险） |
| 5 | 群里没触发关键词的消息，附件根本不会下载（`attachmentProcessor` 是链上第 13 层，在 `mentionGate` 后面） | guard 自己在链头调 qqbot 的下载器，历史条目因此能带路径 |
| 6 | 不想动 qqbot 的 `dist` 文件（升级即失效） | 全部走进程内原型补丁，升级 qqbot 不影响本插件文件 |

> 用之前先确认两项前提：QQ 群内该机器人设为「获取群内全部消息」，且 DSH 的 qqbot 插件开着
> 「群聊仅回复 @ 机器人的消息」。缺任一条关键词都不生效，详见[使用前提](#使用前提两条缺一不可)。

**为什么改成伪造 mentions 而不是往日文里塞 `<@appId>`**：`historyBuffer` 是第 4 层、在门控（第 5 层）
之前记录 `ctx.message.content`，往里插标记等于把 `<@102000000>` 写进群历史，再被 `buildAgentBody`
原样拼进 prompt。伪造 `mentions[].is_you` 能达到同样效果且不碰正文；真实 @ 的标记同理，会被搬进
mentions 后从正文摘掉。

## 为什么和加载顺序无关

`@tencent-connect/qqbot-nodejs` 的 `handleInboundMessage` 在**每次收到消息时**才拼链
（`dist/QQBot.js:387` `const chain = [...this.middlewares, downstream]`），而 `middlewares` 是公开数组
（`dist/QQBot.js:80`）。所以本插件不用抢 `bot.use` 的时机，而是在首条入站消息时
`this.middlewares.unshift(guard)` —— 即使 qqbot 插件先启动、链已经建好，补丁照样生效。

## 安装

两种来源写的是同一个目录 `node_modules/dsh-qqbot-guard`，装其中一个即可：

| 来源 | 怎么装 | 谁负责升级 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 插件市场 / npm | 市场里搜 `dsh-qqbot-guard`，或 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-qqbot-guard` | 你自己（市场安装的版本优先） |
| dsh-android 内置 | 随 APK 的 `plugin-seed` 自动复制进 profile | App 发新版时顺带升级 |

`PluginSeed` 每次开机比较「内置版本」与「profile 已装版本」（semver）：已装版本有效且不比内置旧就
**保留不覆盖**；只有缺 `index.js`、没有 `package.json`、版本号非法、或内置版本更新时才用资产覆盖。
所以市场装的新版能活过重启，APK 带更新的内置版时也能自动升级。

反过来，从市场卸载不会让它消失：下次启动内置副本会补回（这是「内置插件」的预期行为）。
不想让它工作就设 `enabled: false`，而不是卸载。

1. 先装好 qqbot（`@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot`），本插件靠它才能拿到 bot 实例；
2. 装本插件：市场安装，或 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-qqbot-guard`；
3. 本包自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`（`cordis.patch.yml`，用 `- insert:` 插入 `qqbot-guard` 行），
   被列入 `dsh.profile.bundles` 后会自动生效——**不要**在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里再写一条同 id 的新行；
4. 需要改参数时，三选一（最终都落到同一个 `$DSH_HOME/qqbot-guard.json`）：
   - **设置页（推荐，手机端也能用）**：DSH 里打开「设置 → QQ 守护」，改完点保存，**立即生效、不用重启**；
   - **JSON 后门**：编辑 `$DSH_HOME/qqbot-guard.json`
     （App 里是 `/root/.dsh/qqbot-guard.json`，首次启动由 `PluginSeed` 生成）；
   - **profile patch 覆盖**（能写 YAML 时）：

```yaml
- id: qqbot-guard
  name: 'dsh-qqbot-guard'
  config:
    triggers:
      - '大肥鱼'
      - '小鱼'
      - '鱼鱼'
    qqbotPackage: 'C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot'
    verbose: true
```

5. **重启 App**（bundles 变更不走热重载）。

> 关键机制（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 的 `applyEntryPatches`）：普通 patch 只能改**已存在**的 id，
> 找不到就 `warn` 并跳过；新增插件行只能用 `insert`。所以「只写一条 `- id: xxx` 到 profile patch」
> 会静默无效——踩过这个坑。

`qqbotPackage` 一般**不用写**：插件会按下面的顺序自动定位 qqbot（命中即停）：

| 顺序 | 位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `config.qqbotPackage` / `DSH_QQBOT_DIR` | 显式指定优先，用于非标准布局 |
| 2 | 本插件自己所在的 `node_modules` | profile 布局：`<home>/profiles/<name>/node_modules/…`，**与 qqbot 是同一个目录** |
| 3 | `<home>/profiles/*/node_modules` | 依次枚举各 profile；另含 pnpm 的 `.pnpm` store |
| 4 | `<home>/node_modules`、`<home>/plugins/*/node_modules` | 插件市场早期的平铺布局 |
| 5 | 从 `cwd` 按 Node 规则向上找 | 裸部署/仓库内调试 |

`<home>` 依次取 `$DSH_HOME`、**从本插件的安装路径反推**（`…/profiles/<name>/node_modules/…` → `…`）、`~/.dsh`。
第 2 条是这次修掉的关键：以前候选列表里没有 `profiles/<name>/node_modules` 这一层，手机端（qqbot 由插件市场装进 profile）
每次都「没找到」然后**在第一步直接 return**，关键词放行、原型补丁、历史附件全部静默失效。

只有真的找不到时才需要写死路径：

```yaml
- id: qqbot-guard
  name: 'dsh-qqbot-guard'
  config:
    qqbotPackage: 'C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot'
```

找不到时的日志会列出**试过的每一处**安装路径（而不是只报一句「没找到」），可直接照着补 `qqbotPackage`。

插件声明 `inject: ['agents']`，与 qqbot 插件同级，谁先启动都行。

> APK 内置时不写 `dependencies`：`PluginSeed` 只把目录拷进 `node_modules` 并登记
> `dsh.profile.bundles`。`file:` 依赖会绑死容器路径，而 loader 按名字解析，够用。

### 配置项

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；`false` 时插件什么都不做，qqbot 行为保持原样 |
| `triggers` | `['大肥鱼', '肥鱼', '鱼鱼']` | 关键词列表，正文包含任一词即视为对我说话 |
| `ignoreCase` | `true` | 关键词是否忽略大小写 |
| `qqbotPackage` | `''` | dsh-qqbot 安装目录或它的 package.json；留空则自动探测（本插件同 profile 的 `node_modules` → `DSH_HOME/profiles/*` → `DSH_HOME` → `cwd` 向上） |
| `configFile` | `''` | 外部 JSON 配置路径；留空时依次取 `$DSH_QQBOT_GUARD_CONFIG` → `$DSH_HOME/qqbot-guard.json` → `~/.dsh/qqbot-guard.json` |
| `faces` | `true` | 把 `<faceType=…>` / `[<face,id=N/>]` 还原成 emoji；关掉则保持上游原样（上游会直接删标签） |
| `historyAttachments` | `true` | 往群历史条目里补附件摘要（`[图片「a.png」]`）；关掉则历史里只剩文字 |
| `strictVersion` | `false` | SDK 版本超出白名单 `>=1.0.5 <2.0.0` 时是否放弃安装 |
| `verbose` | `true` | 是否打印诊断日志，就绪日志会带上「配置源=…」 |

配置优先级：`DEFAULT_CONFIG` < 外部 JSON 文件 < cordis 里的 `config`。JSON 解析失败只会打一条
warn 然后忽略，不会让插件挂掉——手机上手改坏了不会变砖。

## 设置页（可视化配置）

包导出 `./client`（`dsh.client.platform = web`），在 DSH 里注册一个设置板块「QQ 守护」：

![设置 → QQ 守护](docs/settings-qqguard.png)

- 顶部状态行：qqbot 是否定位到、装在哪、SDK 版本、history 补丁是否生效——`找不到 qqbot` 这类
  故障不用再翻 App 日志；
- 关键词用每行一个的 textarea 编辑（空行忽略、自动去重），开关直接点；
- 保存写的还是 `$DSH_HOME/qqbot-guard.json`（原子写：临时文件 + rename，不会写坏）；
- guard 每收一条消息前检查文件指纹（mtime + size），变了就重新读——**保存即生效**，
  在设置页和手改 JSON 之间来回切换也不会打架。

接口是同源的 `GET/PUT /qqbot-guard/config`：只接受回环地址的 Host、拒绝跨站 Origin，
请求体上限 64 KB，未知字段直接 400（防止手滑写进错字段还静默忽略）。

## 自检

```bash
node --test                     # 定位逻辑 + apply() 端到端回归（不需要真的装 qqbot）
DSH_QQBOT_DIR=/path/to/node_modules/@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot node selfcheck.mjs
```

`discovery.test.mjs` 在 tmp 里造出设备上的真实布局（guard 与 qqbot 同在
`profiles/web/node_modules`、`DSH_HOME` 未设、cwd 为空的 `work` 目录），断言能定位到包；
`boot.test.mjs` 用假 qqbot 跑一遍 `apply()`，断言不再在第一步退出、且群消息关键词能补上
`mentions.is_you`。这两个用例在旧实现上都会失败（失败点正是「没找到 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot」）。

自检会：先按 qqbot 原样建 bot（补丁前）→ 装补丁 + 包装 history store → 喂五条消息
（闲聊 / 关键词 / 真 @ / 表情占位符 / 纯图片），断言链头部是 guard、关键词消息被处理、
`wasMentioned=true`、正文无 `<@` 标记、闲聊消息仍被拦、群历史已累积、历史条目无 `<@` 残留、
空 ext 的表情变 `[表情]`、命名表情解码成名字、老格式表情仍查表、历史里有附件摘要。

### 实测结果（qqbot 0.5.3 + qqbot-nodejs 1.0.5，Node 24.21.0）

```
qqbot=0.5.3 sdk=1.0.5 chain=14
PASS  补丁已安装
PASS  链头部是 guard
PASS  补丁未改变原链长度（懒注入时机正确）
PASS  关键词消息被处理
PASS  关键词消息 wasMentioned=true
PASS  模型收到的是干净文本（无 <@ 标记）
PASS  无关键词的消息被门控拦下
PASS  群历史已累积
PASS  history store 已包装（附件摘要生效）
PASS  历史条目无 <@ 残留
PASS  空 ext 的表情标签变成 [表情]（历史里）
PASS  空 ext 不猜 faceId 对照表
PASS  命名表情解码成名字（264 → 捂脸）
PASS  老格式 [<face,id=1/>] 仍查表
PASS  历史里带附件摘要
PASS  历史里补上附件真实路径
PASS  附件路径是 POSIX 风格绝对路径
PASS  附件在 guard 里就预下载（不等 mentionGate）
PASS  预下载路径直接进历史（不靠 glob 兜底）
PASS  没有本地文件时不硬写路径
PASS  表情标签不再以占位符形式出现
```

全量模式（`requireMention: false`，群消息全收）下同样有效：history 为
`["闲聊一句","YONGJIE 关键词","真 @ 一句"," [图片「a.png」]"]`，关键词消息被标成 `wasMentioned=true`。
注意全量模式本来就全放行，这里的差别只是「标记成在跟我说话」——模型会看到 `(@you)` 并拿到群历史。

## 使用前提（两条，缺一不可）

关键词放行要成立，得同时满足「非 @ 的群消息能进到 SDK」和「qqbot 的门控在拦非 @ 消息」。
任缺一条，现象都是「关键词没反应」，但原因完全不同：

| # | 前提 | 在哪里设置 | 缺了会怎样 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 机器人在该群能拿到**全部**群消息 | QQ 群里打开机器人 → 设置 → 「机器人可获取的群聊消息范围」→ 选「获取群内全部消息」 | 群友不 @ 、只打关键词的消息**根本不会被推送**，`handleInboundMessage` 收不到，guard 无从触发 |
| 2 | qqbot 开启「群聊仅回复 @ 机器人的消息」（配置键 `requireMention: true`） | DSH 的 qqbot 插件设置页把该开关打开；或写进 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `im-qqbot` 条目 | 门控对所有群消息一律放行，插件只剩「补标记」作用，群里每句话都会触发回复 |

前提 2 的开关开启后，界面上会标注「开启后，机器人仅可回复 @ 机器人的群聊消息」——这正是本插件要钻的那道门。

群聊要「只有 @ 或命中关键词才回」，**必须**把 qqbot 的 `requireMention` 设为 `true`
（`cordis.patch.yml` 里 `im-qqbot` 条目）：

```yaml
- id: im-qqbot
  config:
    requireMention: true
```

原因：本插件的做法是把命中关键词的消息「伪装成 @」再交给下游 `mentionGate`；若 `requireMention: false`，
门控对所有群消息一律放行，插件就只剩「补标记」作用，群里每句话都会触发回复。

未 @ 的消息不会丢上下文：`dsh-qqbot/dist/gateway/middleware-setup.js:29` 把 `historyBuffer` 放在
`mentionGate`（`:41`）**之前**，且带 `recordOnSkip: true`，被门控拦下的消息照样计入群历史。

## 已知风险

1. **模块实例一致性**：补丁打在 `@tencent-connect/qqbot-nodejs` 的 `QQBot.prototype` 上，必须和 qqbot 解析到
   同一个文件。本插件按 Node 的 `node_modules` 向上查找规则、从 qqbot 安装目录出发定位 SDK，正常情况下即同一实例；
   若装了多份 SDK 且版本不同，可能出现补丁打在另一份上而静默失效（此时 `/消息` 行为与未装插件一致）。
2. **`node_modules` 解析**：`qqbot-nodejs` 的 `exports` 只有 `import` 条件，`createRequire().resolve()` 在 Node 24 会抛
   `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`（实测）。本插件因此手工读 package.json 的 `exports['.']`，不依赖该 API。
3. **历史带标记（已解决，留档）**：早期版本往正文前置 `<@appId>` 来伪造提及，导致群历史条目里带
   `<@102000000> …` 并被原样拼进 prompt。现在改为伪造 `mentions[].is_you`，并把真实 @ 的标记搬进
   mentions 后从正文摘掉，历史是干净原文。代价是多改一个字段（`msg.mentions`），见「已知风险 1」同款顾虑。
4. **附件会被下载两次（仅触发消息）**：关键词触发的消息里若有附件，guard 先下一次，随后
   `attachmentProcessor` 又下一次——media 目录里会多一个同内容的随机名副本。这是为了“没触发的消息也能在
   历史里点开”付出的代价；`historyMedia: false` 可以关掉预下载（回到只有文件名）。
5. **历史里的附件路径只在 24 小时内有效**：上游把附件下载到 `~/.dsh-qqbot/media`，文件名是
   `<原名>_<时间戳>_<随机><ext>`（`attachment.js:60` `uniqueFilename`），后缀随机，**落库时算不出来**，
   而且下载发生在中间件链之后——所以本插件改成在读历史时按 `<原名>_*` 前缀匹配、取 mtime 最新的那个来补路径
   （`resolveMediaPath`）。代价与边界：
   - 媒体默认 24 小时过期（`config.media.ttlHours` 默认 24，`0`=永不过期，每小时扫一次），过期后历史里的
     路径点开就是空的——路径只当“可能还在”的线索，别当保证；
   - 只保留最近 200 条带附件的消息摘要（`notes` 上限），更早的条目退化成纯文字；
   - 文件名重复（同名文件在同一次会话里发多次）时取最新的那个，可能张冠李戴。
   本插件不复制、不移动用户的媒体文件。
6. **表情 vs 收藏表情包（实测结论）**：`faceId` 是系统表情编号，`ext.text` 才是语义来源——
   系统表情会带名字（如 `faceId=264` → `{"text":"捂脸"}`）。**收藏的表情包不走 faceId**：QQ 把它作为
   图片附件下发（落到 `~/.dsh-qqbot/media/`），同时附一个空文本的 face 标签（`faceType=6,faceId="0"`）。
   所以本插件对空 `ext.text` 只给 `[表情]`，不再按 faceId 表猜 emoji（早期版本把 0 映射成 😊 是错的）。
   若想换措辞改 `normalizeFaces` 的兜底值。
7. **版本漂移**：只用 qqbot/SDK 的四个公开面 —— `middlewares`、`handleInboundMessage`、`ctx.bot.appId`、
   `ctx.state.mention`，外加 `history-store` 的 `getHistoryStore()`（拿不到就只打 warn，附件摘要自动关）。
   白名单外的版本仍会尝试安装并打 warn，出问题先跑 `selfcheck.mjs`。

## 边界

- 不改 qqbot 源码，不写 `node_modules`，不碰 App 的 Java 层。
- 媒体缓存、脚本、手册等其余增强项不在本插件范围内（另行安排）。

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。Copyright (c) 2026 anwesc。

# HiveMemory

[English README](README_EN.md) | [项目文档索引](docs/PROJECT.md) | [当前架构](docs/architecture/overview.md) | [安装与启动](docs/help/setup.md) | [开发路线图](docs/ROADMAP.md)

> 为 LLM Agent 设计的持久化记忆与知识共享系统
> *The Hippocampus for Artificial Intelligence*

HiveMemory 是一套面向 LLM Agent 的持久化记忆管理系统，目标是解决长上下文遗忘、跨会话知识无法复用、以及多 Agent 协作中的信息孤岛问题。系统会将对话中的高价值信息沉淀为可检索、可更新、可使用的记忆，并通过统一协议将这些记忆重新注入到后续任务中。

当前仓库已经提供可运行的 Python 后端、前端开发界面、向量存储与缓存基础设施，以及由顶层 HiveMemory System 装配 workspace、Gateway、Patchouli 与 Alice 的 v0.7.2 内容基线。v0.7.0 完成了向 Workspace 网络与任务进程架构的演进：任务请求经唯一注册入口登记为任务进程，Agent 的资源操作经 workspace 能力层逐次授权，执行者经 CPU 端口接入、可以替换。v0.7.1 以 plugin 模式接入了第一个外部 harness Claude Code：Claude Code 的对话经 Import Bus 回流进入记忆生成，Claude Code 的 agent 经 MCP 工具检索与读取记忆。v0.7.2 改进生成质量：生成材料不再按单轮截断，结算来源覆盖已折叠的轮次；一个话题一次提取多条记忆；查重命中后先落库、再合并两条相似的记忆，不再整体覆盖；Claude Code 的 agent 也能经 MCP 工具写入与更新记忆。

## 发布状态

- 最近已发布基线：`v0.7.2`（生成质量，见[收尾审计](docs/archive/plans/v0.7.2-release-closeout-audit.md)）
- 下一计划版本：`v0.7.3`（版本目标未定，见 [ROADMAP](docs/ROADMAP.md)）
- 代码与包版本：`0.7.2`
- Python 要求：`>=3.12`

## 当前版本已提供的能力

### 对话与接入模式

- **主动模式（Active mode）**：通过 `POST /api/v1/chat` 提供 SSE 流式对话。每次请求经 workspace 的唯一注册入口认证并登记为任务进程，由 `TaskProcessService` 驱动 Gateway 分析、Patchouli prepare/finalize 与经 CPU 端口的 Alice Agent 执行；`POST /api/v1/chat/stop` 停止进程，客户端断连按停止处理
- `POST /api/v1/chat` 支持在请求体中携带 `generation_options`（`model` / `temperature` / `top_p` / `max_tokens`）作为单次对话覆盖参数，不会写入全局配置文件
- **Import Bus（外部 harness 导入）**：通过 `POST /api/v1/import/turns` 导入外部 harness 一轮已结束交互的完整记录（用户消息、回复、思考、外部工具的调用与结果、结局）。请求经统一认证网关与导入授权，由 System 层的 Import Bus 编排 Gateway 话题落位、共用封口与 Patchouli 感知提交，交互应用完成后才确认；外部 harness 写入记忆时，它为进行中的一轮就地落位，这一轮回流时沿用落点；它只向记忆网络输入，不检索记忆，也不返回记忆上下文
- **MCP 记忆访问**：`POST /mcp` 是外部 harness 使用的 MCP 端点（streamable HTTP，无状态，只接受本机地址），提供检索、读取、写入与更新四个工具（`memory_search`、`memory_read`、`memory_write`、`memory_update`）。每次工具调用经统一认证网关取得一份请求级访问 context，按 Workspace 访问登记的白名单逐次授权，不建任务进程；写入与更新与主动链路共用同一意图登记与生成链路，返回 pending alias
- **Claude Code 插件**：`integrations/claude-code/`（插件 `hivememory-connector`，本地 marketplace `hivememory-local`，只用 Python 标准库）同时提供对话回流与记忆访问。连接器在轮次结束与会话开始、结束时把 Claude Code 会话记录中已结束的轮次导入 HiveMemory，网络提交在脱离 Claude Code 的后台进程中完成；插件声明的 MCP server 让 Claude Code 的 agent 检索、读取、写入与更新记忆，`PreToolUse` hook 在写入与更新前补上当前一轮的信息。两者都以 Claude Code 自己的接入登记 `harness:claude-code` 认证，HiveMemory 一侧的 `HIVEMEMORY_CLAUDE_CODE_TOKEN` 与 Claude Code 一侧的 `HIVEMEMORY_TOKEN` 需配置同一份凭据；`configs/workspace_actors.yaml` 为 Agent `claude_code` 登记了检索、读取、写入与更新。安装与配置见[接入 Claude Code](docs/help/claude-code-plugin.md)
- **DeepSeek Harness 插件**：`integrations/deepseek-harness/`（dsh bundle `hivememory-connector`，只用 Node 标准库）同时提供对话回流与记忆工具。dsh 中一轮结束、会话创建或恢复时，插件经 dsh 的会话查询服务读取已结束的轮次导入 HiveMemory；四个记忆工具注册为 dsh 原生工具，写入与更新时插件以调用方会话的当前一轮补上轮次信息。以 `harness:dsh` 认证，HiveMemory 一侧的 `HIVEMEMORY_DSH_TOKEN` 与 dsh 一侧的 `HIVEMEMORY_TOKEN` 需配置同一份凭据，`configs/workspace_actors.yaml` 为 Agent `dsh` 登记了检索、读取、写入与更新。支持 Windows 桌面端连接 WSL 中的 HiveMemory，安装与配置见[接入 DeepSeek Harness](docs/help/deepseek-harness-plugin.md)
- **HiveMemory 使用手册 skill**：`integrations/claude-code/skills/hivememory/SKILL.md` 引导 agent 主动检索、写入与修正记忆，并与 harness 自己的记忆共存。Claude Code 插件自动加载它；DeepSeek Harness 等其他 harness 把它复制到自己的 skill 目录使用，见两份接入手册
- **会话**：支持新建、恢复、重命名与删除；Alice 按模型预算自动精简旧工具结果并生成接力摘要，原始对话完整保留，可查看摘要与压缩边界；有输出的取消与失败轮次保留结局。会话与检查点仅在后端进程内保存，重启后消失；Topic 独立作为记忆材料。
- **系统指令**：Gateway 只解析命令，识别为命令的消息以命令终态结束、不进入普通对话；当前版本不执行内置命令。

### Workspace 与访问

- 两类访问登记（`configs/system_principals.yaml` 与 `configs/workspace_actors.yaml`）经两阶段认证，决定谁能以哪个 Agent 进入哪个 Workspace；Agent 的操作权限只由访问登记的 actor 操作白名单表达，Agent Profile 不承载权限；
- Agent 的资源操作（MTP 的 SEARCH、READ、RUN、WRITE、UPDATE、CALL）经 workspace 能力层逐次授权；CALL 派生的子 Agent 作为执行线程，以被调用方身份运行；
- Memory、Topic 和附件携带明确的 Workspace 归属，资源 owner 先校验归属，再按资源 policy 判断可见性；
- 写入意图登记与引用读取缓存由 workspace 持有，正式记忆变更会失效原子与 Profile 解析缓存；完整边界见 [Workspace](docs/workspace/README.md)。

### Chat 附件

- 通过 `POST /api/v1/workspace/assets` 上传 TXT、Markdown、DOCX，确定性解析后 READY 表示可显式选择进入 Chat；
- AttachmentCompiler 按预算编译上下文，成功 Interaction 记录使用关系，Memory CREATE/UPDATE 按需生成来源 Artifact；
- WorkspaceAsset 仅承诺当前进程内可用；完整链路见 [Chat 附件链路](docs/system/attachments.md)。

### 记忆、话题与 Agent 管理

- 记忆的创建、语义搜索与列表、读取、编辑、反馈与删除：`/api/v1/memories`
- 记忆生成任务的查询与取消：`/api/v1/memory-tasks`
- 活跃话题列表、手动结算与驱逐：`/api/v1/topics`
- Agent Profile 的创建与列表：`/api/v1/agents`

### 配置与可观测性

- 运行时配置的读取、更新与默认值：`/api/v1/config`
- 模型与 Provider 注册表：`/api/v1/models`、`/api/v1/providers`
- 运行时事件状态与 SSE 流：`/api/v1/runtime-events`
- WebSocket 日志流：`WS /api/v1/ws/logs`
- 健康检查与就绪检查：`GET /health`、`GET /health/ready`

### 核心能力

- 分层架构：顶层 `HiveMemorySystem` 装配同层的 workspace、Gateway、Patchouli 与 Alice
- Gateway 系统入口：命令解析、话题路由、查询分析、取消/超时和保守降级
- 进程内运行时总线：AsyncSystemBus / GlobalSystemBus / 子系统私有 bus
- MTP（Memory Tool Protocol）协议，支持 `SEARCH / READ / RUN / WRITE / UPDATE / CALL`
- 基于 Qdrant 的持久化记忆存储
- Dense + Sparse 的混合检索路径
- 前端开发界面（Vite + React）

## 架构概览

HiveMemory 当前实现按依赖分层组织。顶层 System 负责组合、门面与生命周期，共享运行时机制位于 `components`，认证、能力层与资产设施位于 `workspace`；Gateway 负责入口决策，Patchouli 负责记忆域能力，Alice 负责 Agent 执行与 MTP/工具运行时。

### 主要运行时组成

- **HiveMemorySystem**：组合根与门面，装配共享运行时、workspace 设施、应用服务、Gateway、Patchouli 与 Alice
- **Workspace 设施**：认证网关与访问登记、能力层（root API 与 actor API）、会话资源、读取视图与写入意图登记、WorkspaceAsset
- **TaskProcessService**：任务请求的唯一注册入口（`workspace.process`），认证后登记任务进程并以 `process_id` 统一进程标识，按 `Gateway -> prepare -> Actor 执行（经 CPU 端口，当前为 Alice） -> finalize` 四阶段编排；进程持有自己的 task 与输出通道，Actor 阶段内的执行线程由进程的线程表登记
- **GatewaySystem / GatewayRuntime**：入口决策子系统，负责系统指令解析、话题路由、查询分析与稳定决策投影
- **PatchouliSystem / PatchouliRuntime**：记忆子系统宿主与运行时，管理 retrieval、perception、generation、lifecycle 与 storage 能力
- **Retrieval Familiar**：Hot Path 检索服务，负责混合检索、重排序、上下文渲染
- **Librarian Core**：Cold Path 记忆服务，负责话题感知、记忆提取、生命周期维护
- **AliceSystem / AgentRuntime**：Agent 执行子系统，通过 CPU 端口交付运行结果，内核工厂装配 Agent loop 与 Koakuma 工具 runtime
- **KoakumaRuntime**：Alice 在 Agent 生成过程中使用的 MTP/工具执行器

### 热路径 / 冷路径

- **Hot Path（热路径）**：追求低延迟，负责当前请求的检索与上下文注入
- **Cold Path（冷路径）**：异步执行，负责对话后的整理、总结、写入、更新、归档

这套拆分使 HiveMemory 能同时兼顾：

- 对当前对话的快速响应
- 对历史知识的持续沉淀与复用

### MTP：记忆工具协议

HiveMemory 提供一套进程内协议，让 Worker Agent 可以在生成过程中主动访问记忆层：

- `SEARCH`：模糊检索，返回候选记忆索引
- `READ`：读取具体记忆内容
- `RUN`：执行系统工具或记忆中的代码片段
- `WRITE`：主动提交新的记忆写入意图
- `UPDATE`：主动提交已有记忆的更新意图
- `CALL`：挂起当前 frame 并委派给子 Agent

协议格式为：

```text
⟪ VERB | TARGET | key="value" ⟫
```

完整协议见 [docs/contracts/mtp.md](docs/contracts/mtp.md)，总体设计入口见 [docs/PROJECT.md](docs/PROJECT.md)。

## 环境要求

运行本项目建议准备以下环境：

- Docker / Docker Compose（推荐，用于一键部署）
- 或手动搭建环境：
  - Python 3.12+
  - Node.js（用于前端开发）
  - 可用的 LLM API Key（例如 DeepSeek / OpenAI 兼容接口）

此外，Embedding 与 Reranker 模型在初次启动时可能需要下载与预热，因此服务启动成功并不等于模型已经 ready。

## 快速开始

### 方式一：Docker 一键部署 (推荐)

如果你只是想快速体验测试版，我们强烈推荐使用 Docker 一键部署：

```bash
# 1. 克隆仓库
git clone https://github.com/artemis03976/HiveMemory.git
cd HiveMemory

# 2. 复制并修改环境变量文件 (填入你的 LLM API Key)
cp configs/.env.example .env

# 3. 一键启动 (包含 Qdrant 和 HiveMemory 后端应用)
docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
```

启动成功后，直接在浏览器中打开 **<http://localhost:8000>** 即可开始使用完整的 Web 界面！

### 方式二：本地开发环境搭建

先复制环境变量模板：

```bash
cp configs/.env.example .env
```

然后按需修改 `.env`。其中：

- `.env` / 环境变量：主要放 API Key、Qdrant 地址、调试开关等
- `configs/config.yaml`：主要放业务逻辑和算法参数（检索、感知、生成、生命周期等）

至少需要检查：

- `HIVEMEMORY__PROVIDERS__DEEPSEEK__API_KEY`（或默认模型对应的 Provider）
- `configs/models.yaml` 中默认模型的 `id`、`litellm_model` 与 `provider`
- `HIVEMEMORY__PATCHOULI__STORAGE__HOST` / `PORT`

### 4. 安装后端

推荐使用 `pyproject.toml` 定义的包安装方式：

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e .
```

如果你需要运行测试或开发工具：

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

### 5. 启动后端服务

推荐使用包脚本：

```bash
hivememory-server
```

默认后端地址为：

- `http://localhost:8769`

服务启动后可先检查：

```bash
curl http://localhost:8769/health
curl http://localhost:8769/health/ready
```

其中：

- `/health` 返回服务是否存活
- `/health/ready` 用于检查模型是否完成后台预热；若仍在预热，会返回 `503 warming_up`

### 6. 启动前端开发界面

```bash
cd frontend
npm ci
npm run dev
```

当前前端开发服务器默认运行在：

- `http://127.0.0.1:5173`

前端开发代理默认转发 `/api` 到：

- `http://localhost:8769`

## 配置模型

HiveMemory 当前采用“环境变量 + YAML”分层配置：

### 环境变量

`configs/.env.example` 展示了推荐格式，环境变量统一使用 `HIVEMEMORY__` 前缀，例如：

- `HIVEMEMORY__PROVIDERS__DEEPSEEK__API_KEY`
- `HIVEMEMORY__GATEWAY__WORKFLOW__DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`
- `HIVEMEMORY__PATCHOULI__STORAGE__HOST`
- `HIVEMEMORY__LOGGING__LEVEL`

### YAML 配置

[configs/config.yaml](configs/config.yaml) 定义默认运行参数，包括：

- `system`、`logging`、`scheduler`、`runtime_events` 与 `i18n`
- `shared`：Gateway/Librarian LLM 引用、Embedding 与 Provider 默认值
- `gateway`、`import_bus` 与 `memory_compiler`
- `patchouli`：storage、perception、generation、retrieval、lifecycle 与 artifacts
- `alice`：Agent Runtime 与 Koakuma

可用模型由 [configs/models.yaml](configs/models.yaml) 单独维护，Provider 密钥通过环境变量或 `configs/providers.secrets.yaml` 提供。

推荐做法是：

- 将密钥、地址、端口、环境切换放在环境变量中
- 将业务逻辑参数保留在 `config.yaml` 中

## 开发者入口

如果你希望直接在 Python 中集成系统，主入口是：

- `hivememory.system.system.HiveMemorySystem`

它提供两种主要接入方式：

- `process_service.register_process()` 与 `run_process()`：主动模式。先由注册入口完成认证并登记任务进程，取得进程句柄；再以 `run_process()` 订阅进程的流式输出，由 `TaskProcessService` 协调 Gateway 分析、Patchouli 记忆准备、Alice Agent 执行与 Patchouli 后处理
- `import_bus_service.import_turn()`：Import Bus，导入外部 harness 一轮已结束交互的完整记录；调用方需先经统一认证网关取得请求级访问 context（HTTP 入口 `POST /api/v1/import/turns` 已完成这一步）

如果你只需要 HTTP 接口，可直接使用 FastAPI 服务；如果你要让已有 Agent harness 的交互沉淀为 HiveMemory 的记忆，并让它读取这些记忆，通常从 `POST /api/v1/import/turns` 与 `/mcp` 开始更自然，Claude Code 插件（`integrations/claude-code/`）与 DeepSeek Harness 插件（`integrations/deepseek-harness/`）是现成的接入实现。

# Balance Whale Intl

**English-first DeepSeek wallet companion for the [DSH Web UI](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

Live wallet balance, real token usage, per-turn cost estimates, sounds, and a draggable card — with **English as the default language** and **简体中文** included.

![Balance Whale in English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Biggy1606/dsh-balance-whale-intl/main/preview.png)

![Balance Whale in Simplified Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Biggy1606/dsh-balance-whale-intl/main/preview-zh.png)

## Why this fork

The upstream [DeepSeek Balance Whale Widget](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget) is Chinese-first: at the version this fork is based on, its README is Chinese-only and the shipped interface is Chinese. The original does not offer an English UI, so this version exists to add one while keeping the same whale-girl companion, live balance, usage view, sounds, and turn notifications.

English is the default here. Simplified Chinese remains available in **Settings → Appearance → Language**, so the widget is still usable by the original audience.

This is an independent fork. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the upstream author.

## Features

- **English by default, 简体中文 included** — switch the whole UI instantly, including labels, notices, dates, counts, status messages, and known balance errors.
- **Live wallet balance** — CNY and USD wallets are shown separately when both exist.
- **Real usage data** — today, current chat, last turn, and last message, using token counts from DSH session logs.
- **Cost estimates** — list-price estimates in Auto, CNY, or USD. The wallet balance itself always stays automatic.
- **Draggable card** — drag the card by its header; double-click the header to re-center it. Position is remembered.
- **Character placement** — drag the character, snap to edges, and mirror it automatically when docked left.
- **Turn and waiting notices** — optional turn-cost bubble, question/approval chimes, and a waiting notice beside the character.
- **Sound presets** — Duck, FX1, Minecraft orb, Task-end A, or Cost, with per-sound previews and volume.
- **Appearance controls** — character, size, animations, glow, secondary currencies, and auto-close.
- **Local-only settings** — preferences are saved in the browser on this device.

### 中文简介

这是 Balance Whale 的英文优先分支。上游项目以中文为主，此版本默认英文，并在「设置 → 外观 → 语言」中保留完整的简体中文界面。余额、今日/本次对话用量、每轮费用、音效、拖拽与吸附等功能都已保留。

## Install

### Requirements

- A DSH Web installation with third-party bundle support (`dsh web`).
- For the wallet balance: a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in DSH's credential service, or a signed-in DeepSeek account.
- Usage statistics still work when balance lookup is unavailable.

### From GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Biggy1606/dsh-balance-whale-intl
```

For a reproducible install, pin the release tag:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Biggy1606/dsh-balance-whale-intl#v1.8.1
```

### From npm

When the npm release is available:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-balance-whale-intl
```

### After installing

Restart `dsh web`, then hard-refresh the browser page (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). If the widget does not appear, check that **Balance Whale Intl** is enabled under **Settings → Plugins**.

### Update or remove

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-balance-whale-intl
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Biggy1606/dsh-balance-whale-intl
```

## Using it

1. The character lives in the bottom-right corner of the DSH window.
2. Click it to open or close the wallet card.
3. Drag the character to move it; release near an edge to snap.
4. Drag the card by its **header** to move it; double-click the header to re-center.
5. Open **Settings → Appearance → Language** to switch between English and 简体中文.
6. Close the card with **×**, **Esc**, or by clicking the character again.

## How the numbers work

- **Tokens are real.** DSH session logs provide the input, cached, and output token counts.
- **Costs are estimates.** They use DeepSeek list prices and do not include discounts, exchange-rate differences, or promotional pricing.
- **Dual currency is one charge, not two.** When both wallets have been used, the same token usage is priced in CNY and USD.
- **Observed wallet spend** is inferred from balance drops while the plugin is running. It is not retroactive and cannot attribute a charge to a specific wallet when both currencies are mixed in one turn.
- The balance lookup uses `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` first, then the signed-in DeepSeek account.

## Data and privacy

- API keys stay in DSH's credential service and never enter the widget's browser code.
- Balance resolution runs in the host process.
- There is no telemetry, analytics, or remote logging.
- Network requests go to DeepSeek's balance API (through the host) and to DSH's local `/balance-whale/*` routes.
- The local ledger at `$DSH_HOME/.balance-whale.json` stores accounting keys, token counts, costs, model/turn names, and the latest turn. It does not store prompts, replies, credentials, or API keys.
- `/balance-whale/state.json` and `/balance-whale/wait.json` are read-only and reject cross-site requests.

## Troubleshooting

**The widget is missing.**  
Hard-refresh with `Ctrl+Shift+R`; if it is still missing, restart `dsh web` and check **Settings → Plugins**.

**There is no sound.**  
Check the volume slider, the master sound switch, and the browser tab/system audio. Preview buttons work even when the master sound switch is off.

**Balance is unavailable.**  
Add a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in DSH or sign in to a DeepSeek account. Usage statistics do not require a balance lookup.

**The cost differs from my DeepSeek bill.**  
The token usage is real; the cost is a list-price estimate. Mixed CNY/USD charging, exchange rates, or promotional pricing can make the platform charge differ.

**I want the original layout back.**  
Open **Settings → About → Restore defaults** to reset the widget settings and center the card. The selected language is kept.

**The character does not sit exactly at the edge.**  
Make sure **Snap to edges** is enabled, then drag close to the edge and release.

## Development

The browser client is generated from `ui.html`, `ui.css`, and `ui.js` into `client.js`. Edit the source files, then rebuild:

```sh
npm run build
npm run check
```

`npm run check` verifies that `client.js` embeds the current UI source, that the package and bundle names agree, and that the JavaScript parses.

```text
index.js              host: balance lookup, usage ledger, local JSON routes
client.js             generated DSH client bundle
client.template.js    wrapper used by scripts/build.mjs
ui.html               widget markup
ui.css                widget styles and design tokens
ui.js                 UI controller and i18n catalogs
locale/en.json        plugin metadata (English)
locale/zh.json        plugin metadata (Simplified Chinese)
scripts/build.mjs     reproducible client bundler
scripts/check.mjs     bundle and metadata checks
assets/               character art, icon, and audio
preview.png           English preview
preview-zh.png        Simplified Chinese preview
ASSET_PROVENANCE.md   asset source, checksums, and as-is terms
NOTICE                third-party notices
```

The client uses a Shadow DOM host and registers a `shell.overlay` slot. The host plugin reads the DSH balance API and session logs; the browser code only talks to the local `/balance-whale/*` routes.

## Compatibility

Built for the DSH Web UI (`dsh plugin --profile web`). The plugin declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and a `dsh.client` entry in `package.json`; dsh.so lists compatibility as **Declared** until it is independently tested.

## License and assets

The JavaScript, CSS, and this repository's own code are **MIT-licensed**. See [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

The character art, icon, GIF, and sounds come from the upstream project and are redistributed **as-is**. They are **not** MIT-licensed by the upstream project; see [ASSET_PROVENANCE.md](./ASSET_PROVENANCE.md) and [NOTICE](./NOTICE). Do not relicense the art or audio under this repository's MIT license.

Upstream project and original concept: [MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget).

## Version

`1.8.1`
